versions.changelog:
- Added explicit instruction: Never install or upgrade the CLI unless the user explicitly requests it.
- Introduced strict file access rule: for any command reading/writing a file (like `draft`, `publish`, `delete --file`), default to `content/posts/` within the current workspace and do not access external paths without explicit user approval.
- No other functional changes. All command mappings and behavioral rules remain unchanged.

Version 1.0.3

- Added OpenClaw-style structured metadata block for install instructions and requirements.
- Moved installation and binary requirements to the new `metadata` field.
- No changes to skill routing, commands, or user-facing documentation content.
- Internal metadata is now more compatible with agent skill registries and OpenClaw tools.

- Updated version to 1.0.2 with no code changes.
- Clarified and shortened the description in the skill summary.
- No functional or behavioral changes; all command mappings and agent protocols remain unchanged.
